hero_h1: A fresh produce business, first and foremost.
hero_lead: Bungle Group is a fresh produce marketer, exporter and supply chain business — founded in 2008, family-owned, and built on the marketing and export of premium Australian citrus and table grapes. That is still what we do every day, and it is what everything else we do is built on.
who_heading: Citrus and grapes are the cornerstone of everything we do.
who_body_1: Everything Bungle does starts with fresh produce. We began in 2008 turning around citrus supply chains — getting the right fruit, at the right quality, to the right place — and that grower-to-shelf discipline still runs through everything we do. In our early years we grew our own fruit and ran a juice factory in Mildura, building deep, hands-on expertise in agronomy and post-harvest science.
who_body_2: We're a science-led business at heart. Our background in agronomy, and our investment in technology, let us measure, manage and protect quality at every step — and they're how we keep pushing the business forward. Product quality assurance isn't a box we tick; it's the standard we hold every line to, every day.
who_body_3: Today we supply premium Australian citrus and table grapes to Australian major retailers every season, and export fresh produce to markets across the Pacific, Asia and the Middle East. That fresh produce foundation has grown to include frozen food, dairy and FMCG grocery — supplied to catering, hotel and institutional buyers across PNG and the Pacific — but fresh produce remains the core.
values_intro: We're an export and supply-chain business, but we run on a simple set of principles — and they don't move.
evolution_heading: Bungle changed because our customers' markets did.
evolution_intro: Founded in 2008 as BungleFresh — a fresh produce exporter and domestic marketer. Over 15+ years, as our customer base expanded into Papua New Guinea, the Pacific and Asia, we extended our product range to match what those customers required.
founder_heading: The people who run this business have their name on it.
founder_body_1: Bungle was founded in 2008, built from a single produce export venture into a multi-market food supply operation with staff across Australia and PNG. The business operates across related entities, including Bungle Fresh (the Australian export & supply chain), Bungle PNG Limited (PNG imports and supply chain) and Crop Logistics (our own 3PL logistics business, which also incorporates a dried fruit and cocktail garnish business).
founder_body_2: We are privately owned. No private equity pressure to cut corners, no offshore parent, no conflicting interests. In an industry where suppliers come and go, longevity is integrity made visible — our oldest customer relationships predate our youngest staff members.
